highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release updates the native renderer to Skia m157 without changing managed APIs.
highlights_body: The update retains the m156 glyph-bounds guard. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 while its native engine remains HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer while preserving the previous glyph-bounds guard and leaving managed wrappers and generated declarations unchanged. Graphite Metal requires iOS/tvOS 15 and macOS 12.
